title: Force ECall HLAP Timer Failure
description: Mirrors the old gRPC event-injector's JSON-hot-patch of configureFailureForRegulatoryECall=<timer>FAILED -- forces the next eCall session's T5/T6/T7 HLAP timer to run to real expiry (MSD_TRANSMISSION_FAILURE) instead of the immediate-success bookkeeping path. Applies to the next eCall started after this action, not any eCall already in progress.
